description: Configuration panel remote (JavaScript and CSS assets beside remoteEntry.js) on signalk-nearlcrews-ui 0.14.0, measured at gzip level 9 the way snui-check-consumer measures it. Re-recorded from the 0.11.1 figure of 48,869 bytes: 0.14.0 ships more compact style text, which more than pays for the primitives added since. The gate catches unexpected growth rather than the upgrade itself.
